name: ChapterEvents - Nothing Scheduled Yet
description: A chapter with nothing on the calendar. This state had no frame before, for a reason worth recording: the section used to render NOTHING at all when the upcoming list was empty, so the page simply had no events block and there was nothing to photograph. A reader could not tell the difference between a quiet chapter and a section that had failed to load, and was offered no way to hear about the next one. It now shows the shared empty panel with a subscribe action — which matters more than it sounds, because on a day-one site most chapters are in exactly this state.
